title: Ather 450S Eco 2.9kWh
description: Representing Ather Energy's prowess in the Urban Electric Scooter class, the Ather Energy Ather 450S Eco 2.9kWh is delivers ultra-nimble urban agility for riders navigating congested city centers. A 450cc powerplant pumps out 40 HP and 35 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Step-Through Upright layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
